# AdminUI / antd-layout

> AI reference entry point for the `@adminui-dev/antd-layout` React layout component.
> Source documentation snapshot: `doc-fix2.zip` (18 bilingual documentation pages and 2 category files).

## Product identity
- Main user-facing package: `@adminui-dev/antd-layout`
- Repository: https://github.com/zhouwenqi/adminui-antd-layout
- Documentation: https://adminui.dev/en/docs and https://adminui.dev/zh/docs
- Demo: https://demo.adminui.dev
- This is a React + Ant Design + React Router layout component for SPA projects.

## Read these references
- `llms-full.txt`: complete text of the supplied bilingual documentation snapshot.
- `ai/skills/adminui/SKILL.md`: workflow and usage rules for coding agents.
- `ai/skills/adminui/references/api-verified.md`: API facts checked against the repository's current `main` source.
- `ai/skills/adminui/references/known-issues.md`: documentation defects and unresolved API claims.
- `ai/skills/adminui/references/compatibility.md`: version and dependency notes.

## Important agent cautions
- Use `@adminui-dev/antd-layout` as the application-facing import path.
- Do not assume every helper mentioned in the docs is exported by the public package entry point.
- `setSkinConfig` is exported through the core package barrel via the `StringUtil` star export. `defineThemeSkin` was not found in the current public barrel; do not generate imports for it until a newer installed package declaration confirms the export.
- `ThemeSkin` is re-exported as a type through the core package entry point.
- The supplied docs contain known contradictions and code defects. Consult `known-issues.md` before generating code from the affected sections.
- Repository `main` reports version 1.8.6, while the npm page inspected during this audit reported published version 1.8.4. Do not claim that repository `main` is already published to npm.
